notes: Timeline = gapless mp3 decode (ffmpeg/libsndfile/browsers); Demucs was run on a WAV decoded the same way, so there is no encoder-delay offset to correct for this song. Tempo is constant: 125.175 BPM (period 0.47933 s), fitted over the whole song on drum+mix onset envelopes, phase refined on kick attack times; first beat 0.218 s. Bar phase: beat index 0 is a downbeat; four-on-the-floor kick fixes phase up to a bar, snare-on-2&4 (if present) resolves the rest -- verify sections[] against sections.md and correct analyze.py's SECTION_BARS if the half-bar phase looks wrong. First downbeat 0.218 s; bar k starts at first_downbeat + k*4*period. Envelopes: 100 fps, frame i centred at i/100 s, 46 ms RMS window, one-pole smoothing (10 ms attack / 90 ms release), each divided by its own 99th percentile and clipped to 0..1 (linear amplitude). low <150 Hz, mid 150-2000 Hz, high >4 kHz of the full mix; vocal/drums/bass/other = stem RMS. Onsets [time, strength 0-1] from the drums stem: kick = attack (steepest rise) of the <120 Hz band (331); snare = 1.5-5 kHz attacks whose 0.5-5 kHz noise tail 40-120 ms later is in the loudest local class (209); hat = >7 kHz attacks not within 40 ms of a snare or 30 ms of a kick (298; mostly 8th off-beats). vocal = note onsets from the vocal stem (log-mel flux peaks + legato pitch jumps > 0.8 semitone), including backing vocals / ad-libs.
